svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Head plate 120 x 120 x 12 mm: a 31 mm hole in the middle for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pivot pin and a 10.5 mm hole 45 mm from it for the index pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drop bar: 50 x 50 x 4 mm RHS, 126 mm long, welded square under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the head plate, centred, and at its lower end to the middle of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the shear head's top plate (over the nip line).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot pin: 30 mm bar 55 mm long with a 40 mm collar welded at its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top; a 6 mm hole for an R-clip under the swivel plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Index pin: 10 mm, on a lanyard, through the head plate into one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the two holes in the swivel plate: slit or ring position.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the head hangs from the trolley on the pivot pin and turns

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through 90 degrees when the index pin is out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the head swings freely; the index pin drops in at both
